messages:
maria: Velociti returned the RFI with 3 exceptions: HSM, FedRAMP, and caching/pricing. Need a bundle by EOD Fri.
omar: Copied customer asks: Q12 (HSM), Q24 (FedRAMP), Q38 (caching/token billing).
jess: I will produce the capability CSV and upload the HSM integration diagram.
liam: Draft pricing placeholders for the workbook: 4xA100 commit = $26,000/month; Dedicated overage = $0.55/1k tokens; Hosted gen = $0.03/1k tokens; expected cache reduction ~30% (estimates).
security: Short security answers ready: Private supports customer HSM appliances and customer-managed cloud KMS; Dedicated supports cloud KMS integrations; hosted multitenant does not host customer HSM hardware. Vendor list: AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault, Thales Luna, Utimaco.
jess: CSV snippet (will attach full file):
capability,hosted,dedicated,private,notes
SSO,yes,yes,yes,SAML/OIDC supported
Customer HSM,no,partial,yes,Hosted=no hardware HSM; Dedicated=cloud KMS; Private=on-prem HSM
KV caching,yes,yes,yes,Automatic prefix/KV caching; reduces billed tokens on hits
Streaming,yes,yes,yes,Token streaming + chunked responses
maria: Draft RFI reply text: "Thanks Velociti
Attached: capability matrix, completed security questionnaire, HSM diagram, pricing_estimate.xlsx. Short answers: (1) HSM - Private supports customer HSM appliances and cloud KMS; Dedicated supports cloud KMS integrations; hosted multitenant cannot host customer HSM hardware. (2) FedRAMP - Redwood is not FedRAMP-authorized as of 2026-03-20; we maintain a compliance roadmap and partner-assisted hosting options. (3) Caching/pricing - see attached pricing_estimate.xlsx; prefix/KV caching reduces billed tokens depending on hit rate; worked example included."
jess: Add a line offering a 60-min architecture review with infra/SRE to validate HSM approach.
ops-bot: Reminder: RFI-5987 sign-off due 2026-03-26 17:00 PT. Required attachments: capability_matrix.csv, security_questionnaire_filled.pdf, hsm_integration_diagram.png, pricing_estimate.xlsx. Notifying @maria.
maria: Tasks: jess=csv+diagram, security=questionnaire, liam=pricing workbook, omar=finalize and upload. Target upload Thu 16:30 PT.
omar: I'll assemble the bundle and ping AE for sign-off when complete.
